WITH ab_join AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'missing') as ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
),
mix_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as cnt,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as total
  FROM ab_join
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
mix_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    cnt,
    total,
    CAST(cnt AS FLOAT) / total as share,
    1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ordertypedist) FROM ab_join) as avg_share
  FROM mix_summary
)
SELECT 
  ordertypedist as mix,
  cnt as count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM mix_stats
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC;
